channel.title: Wire — tech digest
channel.description: One digest a day, merged from thirty sources.

item.title: Coding expertise is going to collapse from AI reliance
item.description: The need for ongoing friction in long-term skill formation. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: Cursor Releases Origin as an Agent-Native Alternative to GitHub
item.description: AI coding agent Cursor has launched Origin, a git based code hosting platform embedded inside its AI-powered editor, positioning it as an alternative to GitHub for teams that already work in Cursor. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Apple introduces M6 and M5 Ultra for a big leap in performance and AI compute
item.description: Apple debuted M6 in the new Mac mini and M5 Ultra in the new Mac Studio, providing an extraordinary leap in performance and AI capabilities. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: OpenAI: GPT 5.6 Sol price reduction (until at least Nov 21)
item.description: Pricing information for the OpenAI platform. (1 source: hackernews)

item.title: Import AI 470: No rights for machines; automating environment generation with SPADE; and building better GPU kernels with Hawkeye
item.description: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers. If you’d like to support this, please subscribe. (1 source: importai)

item.title: Microsoft Moves AI Governance From Policy to Runtime Enforcement
item.description: Microsoft has outlined an AI governance architecture spanning nine governance domains and four functions: policy, control, visibility, and proof. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: AWS Lambda functions now support full IAM resource-based policies
item.description: AWS Lambda functions now support full Identity and Access Management (IAM) resource-based policies , enabling platform admins and security teams to define granular access permissions using the full capabilities of AWS IAM. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon EKS now supports multiple external OIDC identity providers per cluster
item.description: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS) now supports multiple external OpenID Connect (OIDC) identity providers per cluster. (1 source: aws)

item.title: SageMaker MLflow now supports customer managed keys
item.description: SageMaker MLflow now enables customers to encrypt their data using customer-managed keys (CMK) through AWS Key Management Service (KMS). (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ECS now automatically detects and repairs container instances with impaired agent connectivity
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now automatically detects and repairs container instances, enabling customers to reduce undetected workload failures and improve application availability without manual intervention. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod enhances support for Ray
item.description: Amazon SageMaker HyperPod now enhances support for Ray with built-in observability, resilient training, accelerated inference and managed development environments. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Aurora now supports PostgreSQL 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23
item.description: Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition now supports PostgreSQL versions 18.4, 17.10, 16.14, 15.18, and 14.23 which include bug fixes from the PostgreSQL community and Aurora-specific enhancements. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Routeup – stable local HTTPS URLs and opt-in public tunnels
item.description: I built Routeup around a simple idea: local apps should use their real names. It was inspired by Portless , but I also wanted built-in public tunneling, selective path exposure, request inspection, and live logs. (1 source: lobsters)

item.description: I wanted to see how a fairly representative Java Spring Boot application behaves on a very small VPS, especially the difference between configured heap and actual JVM process memory. (1 source: rprogramming)

item.title: I cannot survive from burnout
item.description: I burned out two years ago, went through a divorce, and relocated to a new city. I live alone now and care for seven cats. Over the last two years, I’ve tried forcing discipline, making detailed plans, and restarting over and over. (1 source: lobsters)
